arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Korrell argued the district denied over 300 children admission based on race.
General Clement argued the district plan ignores the two most racially concentrated high schools.
Justice Ginsburg asked if schools can have a race-conscious objective without using racial means.

paragraphs: Parents want the court to strike down the district's race-based assignment plan.
The district wants the court to allow race-conscious student assignments.
